result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: header, search, filter chips, promo banner, restaurant carousels, and bottom navigation all look intact. No critical visual defects were found; only minor polish-level observations.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the first card's image (Green Bowl Poké) has a light/white background while the other cards have dark backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use full-width placeholder images or a consistent skeleton/illustration treatment so cards in horizontal rows have uniform visual weight.

issues.description: The '−20%' discount badge on the second card in 'Popular right now' sits partially over the pizza image edge and its dark circular background blends into the dark image, reducing visibility compared to the white '€0 delivery' badge above.
issues.suggestion: Ensure badges have sufficient padding and consistent spacing from card edges across all cards.
